summary: Over MCP without ETSY_MCP_ALLOW_BUYER_PII, hide buyer-bearing learnings (learnings list and its --warnings log), candidates (learnings candidates, confirm, reject, and the recall candidates section) and playbooks (playbook list), and report how many were hidden. The sql tool's guard (buyerSQLBypass in internal/mcp/etsy_buyer_pii.go) also denies the learn tables search_learnings, learn_candidates, learning_playbooks, search_patterns and learn_recall_misses. In MCP restricted mode the listings always use the object form {<items>, buyer_hidden, note?}.
reason: The learnings family emitted CLI-taught buyer query patterns, resource ids and derived families unfiltered over MCP while the conformance gate certified the tools clean.
